question: How many tracks are longer than five minutes?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracks WHERE Milliseconds > 300000

question: Which five genres have the most tracks?
reference_sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS n FROM genres g JOIN tracks t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.Name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the total invoice value for customers in Germany?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(i.Total) FROM invoices i JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'Germany'

question: List all artists in alphabetical order.
reference_sql: SELECT Name FROM artists ORDER BY Name

question: How many customers are there from Brazil?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

Which album has the most tracks?
reference_sql: SELECT a.Title, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS n FROM albums a JOIN tracks t ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId GROUP BY a.AlbumId ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

question: Find the names of all rock tracks.
reference_sql: SELECT t.Name FROM tracks t JOIN genres g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock'

List all distinct countries where customers reside.
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Country FROM customers ORDER BY Country
